protocol.r2: Mean window R2: compute standard 1-SSE/SST separately for each forecast window, centering on that window's actual future target mean; arithmetic mean of valid window scores within each battery/seed/phase, then equal seed and battery weights. Negative values are retained; constant windows or horizons shorter than 2 return NaN. No pooled/global or within-variance-weighted R2. R2 is a reporting metric only; checkpoint selection remains unchanged.
protocol.phase: Three equal cycle spans from first to last observed cycle of each measurement record. Each window belongs to the phase of its forecast start; its full horizon is scored. Boundary-crossing horizons stay in their start phase.
protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-window R2 within battery/phase, then equal battery-record macro. Other metrics retain their original aggregation. Overlapping windows are not independent; no pooled score across datasets.
protocol.prediction: Median (q0.5); WQL at q0.1,...,q0.9; PICP@80 at q0.1/q0.9. No training, clipping, interpolation, smoothing or future target input. Chronos-2 cross_learning=False; one univariate task per window.

r2_source: Per-window predictions re-inferred with saved input/model/seed/batch settings; original RMSE cross-checked
figure_selection: First panel shows the first eligible forecast (65-80), not the observed-period early phase. Middle/late keep their original representative windows; all scores unchanged.
